subject: Tier/SKU path and fallback options for Skyline Pharma
content:
From: Alyssa Gomez <alyssa.gomez@skylinepharma.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Mar 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Packaging guidance — what upgrade/downgrade looks like

Hi Chloe,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We dug through the notes with engineering and procurement. Two quick asks while we line up internal stakeholders: 1) can you summarize the recommended plan(s) for our usage profile (mostly short generations, ~120M tokens/month plus spikes up to 2x monthly), and 2) confirm how downgrades work if we choose a smaller tier after month three — specifically: prorations, data retention of KV/cache, and whether we can keep feature flags (tool-calling, streaming) on a lower tier.

A concrete constraint: our procurement team needs to evaluate a 12-month vs 24-month commit. We also want to understand the tradeoffs for bundling the observability add-on vs including it in the base tier. If you can outline 2–3 package options and the downgrade paths (and any standard discounts for multi-year), that would help us prepare an internal MA/PO request.

Looping in Tom (legal) — he asked for SOW + pricing matrix once we have a recommended path.

Best,
Alyssa
Head of Engineering Operations
Skyline Pharmaceuticals


---
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Gomez <alyssa.gomez@skylinepharma.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Mar 2028 08:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Packaging guidance — what upgrade/downgrade looks like

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the clear asks. Below is a concise options matrix tailored to Skyline's profile; I can turn this into a one-pager SOW + pricing table for Tom.

Option A — Compact (best for conservative spend)
- Hosted API, metered tokens, compact model profile (latency optimized)
- 120M tokens included, overage billed at standard per-token rate
- Feature set: generation + streaming. Tool-calling and long-lived KV are add-ons
- Downgrade path: immediate downgrade takes effect at next billing cycle; unused pre-paid months are prorated as account credit (applied to future invoices). KV/cache retention: 30 days on compact unless add-on purchased.

Option B — Standard (recommended)
- Hosted + optional dedicated pool burst for predictable spikes
- 150M tokens included, discounted overage rate, streaming + tool-calling included
- Observability add-on discounted 50% when bundled in year-1
- Downgrade path: prorated refund or credit for pre-paid term; data retention 90 days; can keep feature flags active for up to 60 days post-downgrade before flags auto-adjust (we'll coordinate migration).

Option C — Enterprise (for high throughput/SLAs)
- Dedicated capacity, SLA-backed latency, long KV retention, advanced routing controls
- Flexible autoscaling and seat-level routing for multi-team use
- Downgrade requires 30-day notice for capacity reallocation; credits applied per contract.

Discounts / Commitments
- Standard multi-year guidance: 12-month commit typically 10–15% on list; 24-month 18–25% depending on committed spend and features (observability included). Exact levels require commercial sign-off (I will route internally).

Next steps
- I can prepare a pricing_matrix_skyline_v1.xlsx and a short SOW. If you like, schedule a 30-minute call Monday to walk through tradeoffs and pilot terms.

Attaching: none (will follow with matrix).

Thanks,
Chloe Martin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.com


---
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Mar 2028 08:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Packaging guidance — Skyline Pharma (approval for discounts / SOW)

Ben, Marissa — forwarding Alyssa's note. Skyline is asking for concrete options and to see SOW + pricing. They may go 12- or 24-month. My initial guidance (below) proposes 10–15% for 12m, 18–25% for 24m. Can we get pre-approval thresholds? Also need to confirm observability bundling: 50% off year-1 if bundled in Standard.

Summary of ask:
- Approve a standard discount band for 12m and 24m (and any seat/throughput thresholds)
- Approve inclusion of observability add-on at 50% Y1 if we bundle
- Quick SOW for Tom + pricing spreadsheet to share after internal OK

Thanks — Chloe


---
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Packaging guidance — Skyline Pharma (approval for discounts / SOW)

Chloe — quick from me:
- Pre-approved discount bands (AE-level): up to 15% for 12-month deals without OD (observability) bundled; up to 18% for 12-months if revenue > $150k ARR OR if customer commits to pilot conversion SLA.
- For 24-month, AE can offer up to 22% but anything >20% needs AM/RevOps sign-off.
- Observability: happy to offer 50% off in Y1 when packaged with Standard or Enterprise but not with Compact.
- Downgrade credits: prorate on remaining pre-paid months; for dedicated capacity there is a reallocation fee that we usually scope case-by-case (call out in SOW).

If you want to offer Skyline an introductory pilot (6–8 weeks) we can provide $10k in platform credits (applied to first invoice) to reduce friction.

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Mar 2028 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Packaging guidance — Skyline Pharma (approval for discounts / SOW)

Chloe/Ben — approve the following play for Skyline (per our risk guidelines):
- 12-month Standard with 150M token commitment + burst: 18% discount off list for year-1; observability bundled at 50% off Y1.
- If they sign 24-month with minimum revenue threshold of $300k ARR over term, increase discount to 22% and include migration_playbook_skyline.docx and a one-time onboarding credit of $15k.
- For downgrades: include explicit 30-day downgrade notice and prorated credits; KV retention defaults to 90 days and can be extended for a fee.

Please attach pricing_matrix_skyline_v1.xlsx and a draft SOW (Skyline_SOW_v1.pdf) when we send to them. Ben — you can approve up to 18% in CLM; Marissa will sign >18%.

Marissa Cole
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

Recommended offer (per Marissa's approval):
- 12-month Standard plan: 150M token commitment, streaming + tool-calling enabled, observability bundled at 50% off for year-1.
- Discount: 18% off list for year-1.
- Downgrade policy: 30-day notice; prorated credit on pre-paid months; KV retention 90 days; flags remain for 60 days post-downgrade.
- Onboarding: one-time migration playbook and optional onboarding credit available for 24-month deals.

Optional pilot: 6-week pilot with $10k in platform credits to apply toward the first invoice (if you prefer to validate throughput/costs before committing).

Next steps:
1) If this looks good, please confirm which term you prefer (12m standard vs 24m).
2) I can issue an updated SOW and HubSpot deal (link: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/56781234) and route for signature (DocuSign link included in SOW).

I've attached the files and included Ben/Marissa for any further pricing questions. Happy to run through on Monday — suggest 30 min to align on procurement questions and the PO flow.

Best,
Chloe Martin
